decisions.title: Freshness is decided by review timestamp vs. commit timestamp instead of the reviewed commit SHA
decisions.reason: The added code only compares `latestCopilotReview.SubmittedAt` against `lastCommitDate` and never inspects the review's `commit_id`, so a Copilot review submitted for an older commit after the new head commit's committer date is incorrectly treated as fresh. The failure scenario follows directly from this timestamp-only comparison; the only unshown assumption is that `lastCommitDate` is the head commit's committer date, which is consistent with the variable name and the candidate's description.
